stills.caption: The house on Halloween night. One projector, indoors, throwing the show out through the windows.
Another moment in the same show. The strip along the porch is driven from the picture in the windows, so the two never disagree.

In close, mid-adjustment. The windows are rear-projected onto fabric from inside the house, and the grid and the layer name in the left one are SurfaceCast's aiming mode - put there to line the picture up with the opening, and driven from a phone by whoever is standing out here looking at it. The strobe and the smoke machine on the display in front run from the same program, over DMX.

video.caption: Nine seconds of it running, from a run-through in September. The two windows are the screen; the strip along the porch is following them.
